items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: He was the musical director for Louis, and the first trumpet player

ctx.x: Silver Brown, yeah. He was the musical director for Louis, and the first trumpet player, and we had Mike McKendrick on banjo, and Yank Porter was our drummer. Louis had gotten a hold of Yank Porter, a drummer from New York. Then the Walton Brothers -- one was playing bass and the other played saxophone.
